# bs_score — OpenClaw

Wrapper for **OpenClaw**. Canonical skill and scorer:
[alexhawat/bs_score](https://github.com/alexhawat/bs_score).

Register this folder as a skill, or load the root `SKILL.md`.

Scoring:

```bash
bs-score findings.json --repo-root .          # installed
uv run bs-score findings.json --repo-root .   # from a clone
```

Install options: [repository README](https://github.com/alexhawat/bs_score#install).
